correctness.rationale: For n>=3 the Fourier multiplier of the Boolean radius-three Hamming ball is sum_{j=0}^3 K_j(k;n)=(t+1)((t+1)^2-3n+5)/6 with t=n-2k. For odd n=2m+1>=5 and nonsquare 3n-5 only the layer h=m+1 is missing; the other square-resonant cases are covered solely by the general rank formula. Translation averaging of arbitrary ℓ1/ℓ∞ projections onto the Fourier-defined range forces the canonical projection I-E_h as minimum norm. Its convolution kernel absolute sum equals 1−2r/2^n+(1/2^n)sum_x binom(n,x)|K_h(x;n)|. Krawtchouk duality and (1-z)^(m+1)(1+z)^m=(1-z)(1-z²)^m evaluate this absolute sum exactly as 1+r(2^(-m)−2^(-2m)), r=binom(n,m+1). Stirling central binomial asymptotics give exponential endpoint norm but vanishing relative nullity. Independent exact Walsh checks n=3..13 and kernel norm checks for all qualifying odd cases confirm the formula; finite calculations are not used as an infinite proof.
